chapter: Pay, the Fletcher Henderson circle and later life
title: Hanging out with Joe Smith and Bubber Miley; Howard Scott
summary: They gathered uptown after work; Howard Scott later left music for the post office and Dance wants to contact him.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, there was something wrong with the damn machine. It knocked the cord -- were you saying you used to hang out with Joe Smith and Bubber Miley?

Joe Smith, Bubber Miley, myself, all, bunch of us, you know, up to the nightclub because Joe was with Fletcher. And Bubber worked with this -- Down here in the Central Park. He worked with this white band. See, Bubber -- (DANCE: Leo Reisman, (CALDWELL) Right, Bubbles (unintelligible), and we'd all -- they'd get through. We'd all go uptown here and hang out with all the musicians and fellows, you know. And we'd sit up there, the six hills (unintelligible). Jimmy stayed open from one hour to the next hour. They'd never close. We'd hang out -- Coleman Hawkins, all of us hang out together, Joe Smith and Kaiser Marshall and a whole bunch

of us, and he was always -- we'd always get together, but he had a tragic -- he had a style. Only one ever could play that style like him was this boy, Howard Scott. And when Joe left, Howard could play just like that style, beautiful style.
Well, what happened to Howard then? When did he quit --
Howard -- Howard quit and went into the post office. He's retired now. But he -- well, I'd like for you to contact him too because he can go away --
